instructions: SECTION 1 · You will hear a woman reporting a lost bag to a transport office.

groups.instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.strategy: Dates and self-corrections are common in Section 1. Write the date in any clear form (13th, 13 or thirteenth).

questions.explanation: She first says 'Thursday the fourteenth' then corrects: 'It was Wednesday, the thirteenth'.

questions.prompt: Location on train: front carriage, on the ________
questions.explanation: 'I put the bag on the luggage rack above my seat'.

questions.prompt: Description: small dark green rucksack made of ________
questions.explanation: 'made of canvas'. Leather is only the straps.
questions.trap: 'Leather' is heard, but it describes the straps, not the bag.

questions.prompt: Feature: badge of a ________ on front pocket

questions.trap: Cards are mentioned — but she keeps them separately.

questions.prompt: Laptop has a ________ with owner's email address
questions.explanation: 'a sticker on the bottom with my email address'.
Said once — numbers in groups help you write quickly.
'Your reference number is LP 2296', repeated by the woman.

questions.prompt: To collect: go to office on Market Street; bring ________
questions.explanation: 'You'll need to bring some form of identification — a passport or a driving licence.' Any of these fits the gap.
